cases.name: inherited override
cases.source:
import unittest
class Parent(unittest.TestCase):
 def test_one(self): pass
 def test_two(self): pass
class Child(Parent):
 def test_one(self): pass
 def test_three(self): pass

cases.name: diamond follows C3
cases.source:
import unittest
class Base(unittest.TestCase):
 def test_one(self): pass
class Left(Base): pass
class Right(Base):
 def test_one(self): pass
class Diamond(Left, Right): pass
